info.name: Netcom E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Production API collection for Netcom E-Commerce Analytics, Universal CRUD Data Engine, and RBAC Authentication system. Built with Python Flask, MySQL, JWT, Argon2id, and NumPy.

variable.description: JWT Bearer token automatically populated upon login

item.name: 1. System & Health
item.description: System health check and database connectivity verification endpoints.

request.description: Checks system operational status and database connection via SELECT 1 ping. Returns HTTP 200 if connected, HTTP 503 if degraded.

item.name: 2. Authentication & RBAC
item.description: JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication, Argon2id verification, and RBAC user management.

request.description: Authenticates as Admin (`admin` / `Admin@123`). Automatically captures and sets the JWT token in `jwt_token` for subsequent requests.

exec: pm.test('Token received and stored in collection variable jwt_token', function () {

request.description: Authenticates as Operations Manager (`manager` / `Manager@123`). Grants read/write permissions on CRUD datasets and order status updates, but denies user administration and record deletion.

pm.test('Response includes user role in data envelope', function () {

request.description: Authenticates as Viewer (`viewer` / `Viewer@123`). Read-only access to BI analytics and dataset inspection. Mutating actions (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) will return HTTP 403 Forbidden.

request.description: Validates the active JWT Bearer token and returns authenticated claims (user_id, username, email, full_name, role).
Returns all registered system accounts. Protected by RBAC: only users with role='admin' can execute this endpoint (returns HTTP 403 for manager/viewer).

item.name: 3. Analytics & Business Intelligence
item.description: Executive KPI aggregation, time-series revenue trends, Black Friday anomaly detection, and operational fulfillment queue.

request.description: Fetches macro KPIs across the platform: total revenue, order count, unique customers, product catalog size, seller network, average review score, status breakdown, and top revenue categories.

item.name: Daily Revenue - Peak Month (Nov 2017 Black Friday)

request.description: Retrieves daily revenue time-series and identifies peak day (Black Friday 2017-11-24: R$ 152,653.74 across 1,166 orders).

item.name: Daily Revenue - Annual Trend (2017 Full Year)

request.description: Returns full 365-day aggregated revenue timeline for 2017 with 7-day moving averages and peak indicators.

item.name: Daily Revenue - Annual Trend (2018 Full Year)

request.description: Returns daily aggregated revenue timeline for 2018.
Executes NumPy statistical anomaly detection on daily sales volumes. Identifies Black Friday 2017-11-24 as an extreme positive spike (Z-Score > 6.0).

query.description: IQR multiplier (1.5 for mild outliers, 3.0 for extreme)

request.description: Executes IQR (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR) outlier detection across daily commerce metrics.
Lists active orders awaiting fulfillment ('processing', 'invoiced', 'approved', 'created', 'unavailable') with calculated SLA status and estimated delivery dates.
Filters operational fulfillment queue by specific order status.

item.name: Operational Queue - Search Orders (Customer / City / ID)

query.description: Search keyword matching order ID, customer ID, or city

request.description: Full-text search on unshipped orders by customer city, state, order ID, or customer ID.
Updates an order's status (e.g. to 'shipped' or 'delivered'). When setting to 'shipped', order_delivered_carrier_date is automatically set to NOW(). Restricted to admin and manager roles.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 OK or 404 (if ID was altered)', function () {

item.name: 4. Universal CRUD Data Engine
item.description: Complete REST API for all 9 platform datasets: Schema inspection, dynamic pagination, multi-column search, sorting, and full Create/Read/Update/Delete operations.

request.description: Returns metadata, record counts, and primary key definitions for all 9 datasets supported by the CRUD engine.
Inspects database table schema: column names, data types, nullability, defaults, and primary key constraints.
Inspects orders table column metadata and constraints.

item.name: Get Dataset Schema - Order Items (Composite PK)

request.description: Inspects order_items composite primary key schema (`order_id`, `order_item_id`).

query.description: Search keyword filtered across index columns

request.description: Universal pagination, sorting, and multi-column search across any dataset.
Fetches a single record by its primary key.
Inserts a new record into any dataset. Restricted to admin and manager roles.
Updates non-primary-key attributes of an existing record. Restricted to admin and manager roles.
Deletes a record by its primary key. Highly restricted RBAC: only 'admin' role can delete records.
Fetches a line item using composite primary key path: `/api/crud/order_items/{order_id}/{order_item_id}`.
Fetches payment slice using composite primary key path: `/api/crud/order_payments/{order_id}/{payment_sequential}`.
